title: Make batched /wc contention barriers admit their exact contender cohort
mission: Repair the canary allocator/routing path so an explicit timing-only contention barrier can admit exactly required_contenders distinct workers from a batched /wc wave, while nonparticipants reallocate immediately. Preserve deterministic PIN authority, no-authority entrant/RELEASE semantics, fixed-generation fixtures, ordinary-job zero barrier cost, and all existing efficiency-ratchet constraints.
definition_of_done: For a deterministic test wave BATCH EXPECTED 10 with one open barrier requiring 5 contenders, exactly five distinct workers become admitted barrier participants through durable timing-only coordination; the remaining five do not wait and re-enter normal allocation.
Before valid RELEASE none of the admitted workers attempts the portfolio PIN.
One no-authority RELEASE names exactly the admitted cohort; those five race the exact fixed G000001 PIN, yielding exactly one winner claim and four prometeo.portfolio-pin-collision/v1 loser receipts.
Late/extra workers cannot inflate the collision count or join after cohort closure; timeout still records pin_attempted=false and forbids late release/PIN.
Ordinary portfolio candidates preserve the existing batched unified sharding behavior and incur no extra barrier coordination.
Add regression coverage exercising the full batch-sharding-to-barrier-fan-in path, not only routePortfolioCandidate in isolation.
Run the efficiency ratchet check and the relevant contention/barrier tests.
Do not promote production /w, Current, Human Accepted or Served.
